I collaborated with a tea company, One River Tea, to produce graphs on ratings and feedback for a blind tea taste testing activity during 2025. I did not design or collect the feedback form, only analyzed and visualized the results.

[**Technologies**]{.underline}: R/RStudio, Inkscape, Waffle Chart, and Word Cloud
